Q1 (a) Define the following terms:
i. Loss prevention
ii. Risk
iii. Acceptable risk
iv. Tolerable risk
[2]

important in chemical process industry.
[3]

a repeat event of similar nature?
[2]

concentration of fuel.
[3]


Q4 (a) If the UFL for a substance is 11% by volume at 0.0 MPa gauge, what is the UFL at 6.2 MPa
gauge?
[2]
 (b) One thousand Kilograms of methane escapes from a storage vessel, mixes with air and
explodes. Determine:
(i) Equivalent amount of TNT
(ii) Scaled distance at 50 m from the blast
Assuming an explosion efficiency of 2%. The Heat of combustion of methane is 51,168.75
KJ/kg and energy of explosion of TNT is 4686 KJ/kg.
[3]


Q5 (a) Assume an automobile has four independent and identical tires. The tire reliability is
0.97. If any one of the tires is punctured, the automobile cannot be driven. Estimate the
automobile reliability and failure probability.
[2]
